title: Canonical normalized CE row comparison
statement: For every termwise hypercohomology presentation D and p,q, the canonical first-page row comparison is the unique quotient comparison normalized by the diagonal row-cycle inclusion and row homology projection.

source.document: Stacks Project, Derived Categories and Homological Algebra
source.place: Tags 015J, 015K, 0130 and 012K; normalized CE pages and diagonal row representatives

proof.text: Specialize the proved secondFiltration_row_cycle_comparison to global sections and the presentation filtration. Define rowComparison, rowCycleStep and rowCycleClass as its witnesses. Their three equations are the corresponding choose_spec fields. Monicity of the filtration and cycle inclusions fixes the two lifts; the row-cycle comparison identifies the latter with the hom of the graded-cycle isomorphism, making it invertible. Define rowCyclesIso by asIso. Precompose the quotient equation by this inverse to prove rowComparison_projection. Finally define signedRowComparison by the invertible scalar (-1)^(pq). No witness is chosen from an unproved existence theorem.

proof_origin.place: Normalized CE pages and signed row representatives
